coordinates.source: PNG pixel edges, x right / y down; floating-point landmarks
coordinates.bind: right-facing actor-local units before facing/actor scale; sole baseline y=0
coordinates.chest: CHEST_RECT before TORSO_WIDTH=1.30; shoulder landmarks below are after width
coordinates.runtime: shared rig deformation only; never inspect garment names for registration

body.shoulder_follow: shared shoulder_surface_point; armhole and sleeve root use the same fitted shoulder

head.ornaments: same full head canvas and HEAD_RECT; no per-ornament draw rectangles

weapon.hand_origin: fixed original painted fist joint at the anatomical fitted wrist
weapon.socket_units: zero native hand-local offset; apply actor facing/scale at the existing wrist
weapon.socket_ownership: Original normalized arm artwork and the live rig own the fixed fist joint; no procedural replacement hand or garment offset table.
weapon.visual_handle: weapon-local (0,0) at the original painted fist joint; hand_angle remains animated and weapon rotation remains independent
weapon.collision_authority: unchanged; zero visual handle offset introduces no contact-authority displacement
weapon.rule: Clothing import cannot move the anatomical wrist, resize the painted fist, or redefine its fixed socket.

weapon_layer_constraints.front_sword_blade_and_crossguard: after the holding forearm and before the painted fist
hand_passes: weapon at the fixed original fist joint
original arm mesh rows 24..31 once, at unchanged source UVs and scale
weapon_layer_constraints.ownership: character_sidewalk.draw_held_weapon and draw_grip_front; draw_grip_back is an empty compatibility hook; no garment-specific layer rules
